transcript.text: hoover washer drier showing EO3 wont drain, ive done the filter its clean. H3DS4965DACE. pump just buzzes. do i need a new pump??

Not necessarily yet, as a buzzing sound often means the pump motor is trying to run but is blocked by something small caught in the impeller or hose. Since you have already cleaned the filter and it was clear, the next best step is to check for a blockage further down the line. Please unplug the machine, lay down some towels, and disconnect the drain hose at the back to see if water flows freely from the machine's outlet. This will help us determine if the issue is just a blocked pipe or if the pump itself is jammed internally.

already done that, hose is clear and so is the sink waste. water does drain if i scoop it out via the filter. with the filter out i can spin the impeller by finger and it spins totally freely, no resistance, feels like its not connected to anything. torch shows one fin looks snapped

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump (jammed or failed)]
The fact that the impeller spins freely with no resistance and has a snapped fin strongly suggests the pump is mechanically failed and needs replacing. While this is the most likely cause for your symptoms, I could not find a specific mapping for error code EO3 on model H3DS4965DACE in my current database. To be certain about the correct replacement part, I recommend checking the official Hoover spares list or contacting their support team with your full model number. Alternatively, you can have an engineer diagnose and replace the pump to ensure it is the right component for your machine.
ok so its the pump then. is the pump a separate part from the filter housing on this one? want to be sure before i order. coil reads about 170 ohms on my meter if that helps

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump]
Yes, on this Hoover model the drain pump is typically a separate unit from the filter housing, though they sit close together at the bottom front of the machine. The 170 ohms reading suggests the motor windings are intact, so the issue is almost certainly the broken impeller fin preventing it from moving water. Because I could not find a specific mapping for error code EO3 on model H3DS4965DACE in my database, I cannot be certain of the exact part number. It would be safest to check the official Hoover spares list or contact their support team with your full model number to ensure you get the correct pump. Alternatively, having an engineer replace it ensures the right part is fitted and any electrical connections are safe.
